statements: VC-04.5: "GD->>GS: graph_service_addr.send(GetBotsGraphData)" is now the second call. get_bots_data first sends GetChainPaymentsView to state.agent_monitor_addr, and the diagram shows no such call or participant.
VC-04.5: "GD-->>C: 200 {success, nodes, edges} — from live actor" omits the new "chain" field in the response.
VC-04.5: "GD-->>C: 200 {success, nodes, edges, metadata} — static fallback (bots_handler.rs:236-247)" omits the new "chain" field, and the cited line range has shifted.
VC-04.5: the anchors for the handlers after get_bots_data (bots_handler.rs:250, :400, :699, :791, :889, :596 and :236-247) have moved down because the commit adds lines above them.
reason: The commit adds a new actor round-trip (GetChainPaymentsView to agent_monitor_addr) and a "chain" field to both 200 responses of get_bots_data. The VC-04.5 sequence diagram shows neither, so its call sequence and response payloads are incomplete. Some anchors also moved, but the behavioural changes go beyond anchors.
